verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments product, since self-hostable payment processors exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable deployment of Coinbase Payments. The pack describes a Coinbase-operated custodial service, with SDKs that rely on CDP to secure keys, which is a hosted-only model.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
